name: Name under a photograph
blueprint: A full-bleed photograph fills the top 58% of the 1440×900 viewport, touching the top, left and right edges, `object-fit: cover`, with its focal point in the upper two-thirds. The lower 42% is a flat ground colour that butts against the photograph with no gap. The name runs across this band on one line, spanning all 12 columns between 24px margins, at clamp(120px, 19vw, 300px), tracking -0.05em, line-height 0.85, its descenders on the bottom margin, 32px above the bottom edge, so the name stands whole. Fit the size to the length of the name so it never wraps. In the strip of ground between photograph and name, 24px under the photograph's edge, sits one row at 17px: the supporting sentence on columns 1–5 at the left margin, and the single action as a small solid rectangular button flush to the right margin. Navigation is four text links at 15px laid over the photograph's top-right corner, 24px in, with a flat dark scrim behind that row only if the image is light there. No logo is repeated: the name is the logo. Nothing else is on the screen.
mobile: The photograph takes the top 50svh at full width, re-cropped around its focal point. The name sits under it at 23vw on one line; a name longer than seven characters breaks onto two lines at 21vw, line-height 0.85, and fills the band down to a 16px bottom margin. The supporting sentence at 16px and the action button stack above the name on the left margin. The links collapse to one 'Menu' word over the photograph, top-right.
headline: The name itself on one line, up to about 12 characters at 19vw (drop towards 13vw for longer names), and at most two lines on a phone.

name: Stacked name, two inks
blueprint: One saturated flat field covers the whole 1440×900 viewport and there is no image. The name is broken into two lines and set flush left from a 40px margin at clamp(110px, 15vw, 230px), heavy weight, tracking -0.04em, line-height 0.82 so the lines almost touch. The block starts 14% down and fills the top 58% of the screen; the longer line reaches at least column 11. Line one is set in the light ink and line two in the dark ink, so the break reads as a change of voice: split a two-word name between the lines, or break one long name with a hyphen at a syllable. The top edge carries only small text at 15px, 24px in: a monogram top-left, and two or three text links plus the single action as an underlined link top-right. The supporting sentence, 18px in the light ink and max 30ch, is right-aligned in the bottom-right corner on columns 9–12, its last line 40px above the bottom edge. The bottom-left corner stays empty. The next section begins as a different flat field exactly at the fold.
mobile: The field fills 100svh. The name keeps its two lines and two inks at 21vw, flush left at a 16px margin, starting 18% down; a long name hyphenates rather than dropping below 18vw. The supporting sentence moves to the bottom-left at 16px across the full width, with the action as an underlined link beneath it, 24px above the bottom edge. The top-right links reduce to one word.
headline: The name on exactly two lines, one per ink, each line up to about 8 characters at 15vw on desktop and 21vw on a phone.

name: Photograph for a letter
blueprint: A flat white or pale ground, about 85% empty. The name sits on one line at the exact vertical centre, bold, at clamp(96px, 10.5vw, 168px), tracking -0.04em, spanning 78–88% of the width with equal side margins. One photograph is set into the line as if it were a glyph. Either it fills the word space between first and last name (a landscape frame one x-height tall and about 1.6em wide, resting on the baseline), or it replaces one round letter of a short name (a square frame exactly one cap-height tall). Build the line as an inline-flex row with `align-items: baseline` and size the frame in em so it scales with the type; square corners, `object-fit: cover`. Navigation is small and pushed to the edges: a 15px wordmark or monogram top-left at a 24px margin and up to five text links at 14px spread evenly across the right half of the top edge. Along the bottom edge, on the same margin: one supporting sentence at 16px starting at column 6, and the single action as an underlined text link flush right.
mobile: The name stacks on two centred lines at 19vw with line-height 0.9. The photograph leaves the line and becomes a 3:2 frame at full width minus 16px margins between the two lines, so the screen reads word, picture, word. A single short name keeps the square frame inline at cap height instead. The supporting sentence and action sit under the block at 16px; the links collapse to one word top-right.
headline: The name on one line with a photograph in its word space or in place of one letter, up to about 16 characters at 10.5vw, splitting into two lines on a phone.

name: Name split to corners
blueprint: The name is cut into two halves that stay pinned to opposite corners while the page passes between them. A layer with `position: sticky; top: 0; height: 100svh` and `pointer-events: none` holds both: the first word top-left, 28px from the top and left edges; the second word bottom-right, 28px from the bottom and right edges. Both are set at clamp(72px, 9vw, 140px), line-height 0.85, in white with `mix-blend-mode: difference` so they read on every panel beneath. On the first screen the stage between them is a paper-white panel on columns 1–9 and one full-height photograph on columns 10–12 touching the top, right and bottom edges. The supporting sentence, 20px and max 34ch, starts at column 3 at 44% of the height; the single action is a text link with an arrow directly under it. Three text links are stacked at 15px along the right edge of the white panel at mid-height. The rest of the panel is empty. Later panels, full-height photographs and text panels of different widths, scroll under the pinned halves for three to five viewports; then the layer releases into ordinary sections.
mobile: Both halves stay pinned: the first word top-left and the second bottom-right, each at 15vw with 16px margins. Between them every panel is a full-width photograph 56svh tall followed by its sentence at 17px. On the first screen the photograph crosses the middle band with the supporting sentence and the action link beneath it. The stacked links collapse to one word at the top-right corner.
headline: The name in two halves (two words, or one word cut at a syllable), each up to about 9 characters at 9vw, one per corner, with no other headline.

name: Pinned title over portraits
blueprint: A pale flat ground. The title runs on one line of extra-bold uppercase at clamp(90px, 10vw, 160px), centred, spanning about 82% of the width, its cap line 120px from the top. It lives in a sticky layer (`position: sticky; top: 0; height: 100svh`) stacked above the images and set in one saturated ink that reads on both ground and photograph. Beneath it a single portrait photograph, 2:3, sits centred on columns 5–8 (about 37% of the width) and runs from 90px below the top edge down to the bottom edge, so the title crosses its upper quarter and the middle letters sit on the image. The wordmark sits top-left at 24px in 15px bold; one 'Menu' word sits top-right. Bottom-left on columns 1–3: the supporting sentence as a narrow column at 16px bold, max 26ch, its last line 32px above the bottom edge. Bottom-right: the single action as a solid rectangular button. As the page scrolls, further portraits of identical ratio and position replace the first, three or four in all (they count in the page's three to six photographs), on the page's one ground, before the layer releases.
mobile: The title stays pinned at the top at 17vw on one line, or two lines at 15vw if longer than ten characters. Each portrait becomes full width minus 16px margins at 2:3 and starts behind the lower half of the title. The supporting sentence follows the first portrait at 16px. The action button is fixed to the bottom-right corner, 16px in. The wordmark shrinks to a monogram top-left.
headline: The title of the series, or the name: one uppercase line of up to about 14 characters at 10vw, two short lines on a phone.

name: Sentence with a photo strip
blueprint: A warm flat ground with no navigation bar. One sentence of four or five words runs as a single line of condensed capitals at clamp(120px, 13vw, 200px), sitting on the vertical centre and reaching edge to edge inside 28px margins. Where one word of the sentence would be, a strip of photograph takes its place: a frame exactly one cap-height tall (set in em) and 45–50% of the viewport wide, ratio near 5:1, corners radiused 14px, `object-fit: cover`. Build the line as a flex row with `align-items: baseline` and give the strip `flex: 1` so words and picture always fill the width. The photograph shows the thing the sentence names: a wide view of the place, taken from above or along a horizon, so it survives the letterbox crop. The top third of the screen is empty apart from a 15px wordmark top-left and two text links top-right. About 150px under the sentence the single action sits centred as a small solid button. One supporting sentence at 22px, max 44ch, is centred 48px above the bottom edge.
mobile: The sentence breaks into two lines at 21vw with the strip between them: the first words, then the photograph as a 2:1 frame at full width minus 16px margins with the same 14px corners, then the remaining words. The block is centred vertically. The action button sits 32px under the last line and the supporting sentence under that at 16px. The top links collapse to one word.
headline: A sentence of four or five short words, about 14 characters of type in total, whose missing word is the photograph.

name: Sentence split by a frame
blueprint: A white or pale ground. One short sentence is broken in two and pushed to the edges: the first half flush to the 32px left margin, the second half flush to the right margin, both on the vertical centre line at clamp(40px, 3.6vw, 60px), medium weight. Between them, dead centre on columns 5–8, sits one media frame: 35% of the viewport wide, 16:9, corners 4px, holding a photograph or a working fragment of the product. The frame belongs to a vertical reel: the bottom 60px of the previous frame shows at the top edge of the viewport and the top 60px of the next at the bottom edge, same width, 24px gaps, so the centre column reads as a strip passing through the sentence. The stage is sticky; the reel advances three or four steps while the two halves of the sentence hold their place. Wordmark top-left; three text links and the single action as a small solid button top-right, all at 15px. Bottom-left on columns 1–4: one supporting sentence at 18px, its last line 32px above the bottom edge. The other corners stay empty.
mobile: The halves stack: the first half of the sentence at 9vw flush left under the wordmark, then the frame at full width minus 16px margins and 4:3, then the second half flush right at 9vw. The neighbouring frames show as 28px slivers above and below. The supporting sentence and the action button follow at 16px. The links collapse to one word.
headline: One sentence of four to six words split into two halves of up to about 14 characters each; the frame between them shows what it is about.
bannedWhy: The headline is split in two and a picture frame sits between the halves: a picture between the words of a headline, the device the house rules ban (round 6 integration review).

name: Headline across two fields
blueprint: The viewport is two flat fields meeting at exactly half height: paper above, one saturated colour below, with a hard edge and nothing drawn on it. A two-line headline in black-weight capitals at clamp(96px, 9.5vw, 150px), line-height 0.86, is centred across the seam and spans about 70% of the width, so line one stands on the upper field and line two is cut through its upper third by the seam. The type changes ink where it crosses: above the seam it takes the accent ink, below it a deep ink two steps darker than the lower field, as if submerged. Build it as two stacked copies of the same headline, one per ink, the first clipped with `clip-path: inset(0 0 50% 0)` and the second with `inset(50% 0 0 0)`. Wordmark top-left at 28px; up to four text links and the single action, a solid rectangular button, top-right. One supporting sentence at 20px in the paper colour is centred on the lower field, 56px above the bottom edge. The lower field continues for 30svh past the fold before the next colour begins.
mobile: The same two fields with the seam at 46svh. The headline stays on two lines at 15vw, centred, still cut by the seam and still changing ink. Wordmark top-left and the action button top-right; the links drop into one menu word beside it. The supporting sentence sits on the lower field at 16px, centred, max 28ch, with 40px beneath it.
headline: A statement of two to four words on two lines, up to about 10 characters per line, whose meaning the rising field acts out.

name: Swatch column beside the view
blueprint: A 10px frame of paper colour surrounds the screen. Columns 1–10 are one photograph panel, full height inside the frame, corners radiused 12px, `object-fit: cover`: a wide, calm view with a low horizon and a great deal of sky. The headline is centred in the panel's upper third on two lines of light-weight serif at clamp(72px, 8.6vw, 132px), white, with a flat dark scrim behind that band only if the sky is pale. The wordmark sits top-left inside the panel, 28px in. The single action, a white rectangular button, sits bottom-centre, 36px above the panel's lower edge; one supporting sentence at 18px sits bottom-left on columns 1–4, level with it. Columns 11–12 are both the navigation and a preview of the page: a full-height stack of five flat colour blocks of equal height, butted together with no gaps, each holding one text link at 16px in its top-left corner with 20px padding. The five colours are sampled from the photograph, ordered light to dark, and each is the ground colour of the section its link scrolls to. There is no other navigation.
mobile: The photograph panel takes the top 64svh inside an 8px frame, with the headline at 12vw on two lines in its upper third and the action button at its bottom-centre. The swatch column becomes five full-width bars, each 52px tall with its link at 15px, stacked directly under the panel; the first three show above the fold. The supporting sentence moves into the first section.
headline: A two-line statement of three to five words, up to about 14 characters per line at 8.6vw, set over the sky.

name: Film title, bottom edge
blueprint: One photograph fills the viewport at 100vw by 100svh, `object-fit: cover`, with its subject in the upper two-thirds and a calmer, darker zone along the bottom. The name is one condensed uppercase word, or a short name in a high-contrast serif, set at clamp(150px, 17.5vw, 290px) and sized to span the full width between 32px margins. It is centred and anchored so it stands whole on the bottom margin, its descenders 32px above the bottom edge, covering roughly the lowest quarter of the frame. A flat dark scrim lies under that bottom band only, about 40% of the height; the rest of the image is untouched. Directly above the name's left end, on the same margin, sits the supporting sentence at 16px on two short lines. Directly above its right end, right-aligned, sits the single action as a small paper-coloured rectangular button. The top edge carries a small emblem or wordmark at the left margin and up to five text links at 15px grouped at the right, all in white. The central half of the screen belongs to the view.
mobile: The photograph is re-cropped to portrait with `object-position` on its subject and fills 100svh. The name stays on the bottom margin at 22vw on one line, or two lines at 20vw beyond eight characters, whole, its descenders 20px above the edge. The supporting sentence sits above the name's left end at 15px. The action button moves to the top-right corner and the links collapse to a menu word beside the emblem.
headline: The name of the place: one word of up to about 12 characters at 17.5vw, or two words stacked on a phone.

name: Small name, open sky
blueprint: A single photograph fills the viewport edge to edge with no frame: choose one whose upper 45% is sky, wall or water with nothing in it and whose subject sits low and off-centre. All type is white and stays out of that empty zone. Top-left at a 24px margin, the name is stacked on two or three lines at 14px, like a letterhead. Top-right, three or four text links run in one line at 14px separated by commas, the current one marked by a 2px underline. Bottom-left, 32px from the left and bottom edges, the name repeats as the only larger type: two tight lines at clamp(44px, 4.2vw, 64px), line-height 1.0, regular weight, on columns 1–5. On the same baseline at the bottom-right margin sits the single action as an underlined text link with an arrow, and above it one supporting sentence at 15px, right-aligned, max 32ch. If a lower corner is too bright for white type, darken that corner alone with a flat dark scrim. The page below opens on plain paper with one narrow paragraph and wide empty margins.
mobile: The photograph is cropped to portrait around its subject and fills 100svh, its upper half still empty. The small stacked name stays top-left at 13px and the links collapse to one word top-right. The larger name sits bottom-left at 9.5vw on two lines, 20px in. The supporting sentence and the underlined action stack beneath it at 15px, left-aligned, 24px above the bottom edge.
headline: The name set small on two lines of up to about 16 characters each at 4.2vw; the photograph does the work of a headline.

name: Invitation card, cropped
blueprint: A flat field of one soft colour fills the viewport. Centred on it is a single portrait card in paper colour, 5:7, on columns 4–9, its top edge 190px down and its lower third cut off by the bottom of the viewport, so the page visibly continues as the rest of the card. The card is a filled shape with scalloped inner corners, made with `clip-path` or with four corner circles in the field colour, and no outline. Inside, with 56px padding, everything is centred and symmetrical like letterpress stationery. The two names, or the title, are set in a large italic serif at clamp(56px, 5.6vw, 88px) on two lines, staggered so line one sits left of centre and line two right. Between and beneath them, date, time and place appear as short lines at 15px in sentence case, separated by space and by one solid 10px diamond. The top row sits on the field above the card at 28px margins: a small monogram top-left, three text links centred, and the single action, a solid rectangular button in the ink colour, top-right.
mobile: The card becomes full width minus 12px margins, starts 96px down and is still cropped by the bottom edge, with its scalloped top corners kept. The names stay on two lines at 12vw, centred without the stagger, and the details follow at 15px. The monogram sits top-left and the action button top-right on the field; the three links move onto the card's lower part, below the fold.
headline: The two names or the title on two lines, up to about 12 characters per line, set as they would be printed on the card.
bannedWhy: A headline on a card with scalloped corners, a drawn diamond and a staggered heading: five adjustments deleted all of it (round 11).

name: Card over a dim room
blueprint: A full-bleed, low-key photograph of the room fills the viewport, darkened with `filter: brightness(0.7)` so it reads as atmosphere. Centred over it is one square-cornered panel in a flat warm tone taken from the photograph: columns 4–10, about 55% of the width and 62% of the height, a filled programme card with 32px padding. Along its top edge the three words of the title are spread to the left, centre and right in bold condensed capitals at clamp(28px, 2.5vw, 38px); that line is the headline. Under it sit two left-aligned blocks in the same face and size, line-height 1.0: the facts (date, time, place) as three short lines, then one supporting sentence held to 30ch. Along the card's bottom edge: a credit at left in 14px, the single action as a solid rectangular button in the centre, one text link at right. There is no navigation outside the card. The card is `position: sticky`: as the page scrolls it shrinks with `transform: scale` toward the bottom-left corner and stays there as a ticket-sized stub while photographs of differing sizes pass on a flat ground.
mobile: The photograph fills 100svh and the card sits centred at full width minus 16px margins, 70svh tall. The title words stack as a two-line heading at 9vw at the card's top-left. The facts and the supporting sentence follow at 5.2vw in the condensed face. The action button spans the card's bottom edge. On scroll the card shrinks to a 120px stub pinned bottom-left.
headline: The event or venue name, three words at most and up to about 8 characters each, spread across the card's top edge; two lines on a phone.
bannedWhy: The headline sits in a card on a darkened photo and the card shrinks to a sticky stub; judges read it as a page built from boxes (round 4, r4-p22).

name: Tabbed folder stack
blueprint: A dark flat ground. A slim top row at 24px holds the wordmark dead centre and one text link far right at 15px. The headline is one centred line of heavy condensed capitals at clamp(96px, 10vw, 160px), spanning about 70% of the width, its cap line 110px from the top. Under it one supporting sentence in a serif at 20px, centred, max 46ch. From 51% of the height down the screen is a stack of five file folders: flat colour bands 86% of the viewport wide, centred, each offset 64px below the one behind so only a strip of the back four shows. Every folder has one trapezoid tab rising 40px from its top edge, cut with `clip-path: polygon()`, at its own horizontal position and in its own colour, holding one section name at 18px. The front folder is open and runs off the bottom edge; it carries the single action as a solid button at its top-left with 32px padding. Each folder links to its section and lends that section its ground colour. The tab shape returns as the button's top corners.
mobile: The headline sits 96px down at 17vw on one line, or two at 15vw, centred, with the supporting sentence at 16px beneath. The folder stack starts at 48svh at full width: bands offset 52px, tabs 32px tall with names at 15px, staggered left, centre and right. The front folder runs off the bottom with the action button at full width inside it.
headline: The name or a two-word statement on one line of up to about 12 characters at 10vw; two lines allowed on a phone.

name: Striped card beside the room
blueprint: The viewport is split 50/50 with a 12px gap and 12px outer margins. The right half is one full-height photograph of the room, corners radiused 16px, `position: sticky` so it stays in view while the left half scrolls. The left half is a printed card: a flat paper-colour panel with the same 16px radius, and the subject's stripe (from its awning, label or ribbon) as the only ornament. Across the card's top runs a band 56px tall made of alternating bars of the single ink colour and paper, each bar 28px wide, built as a flex row of filled blocks. The same stripe returns as an 8px band above the footer and inside the button on hover. Under the band, centred: the wordmark about 300px wide, then a two-line headline in a light serif at clamp(56px, 5vw, 80px) in the ink colour, one supporting sentence at 17px held to 36ch, and the single action as a solid rectangular button. Three text links sit in one centred row at 15px, 28px above the card's bottom edge. One ink on paper; the photograph supplies every other colour.
mobile: The photograph comes first at full width inside 12px margins, 48svh tall, with the 16px radius. The card follows and overlaps the photograph's bottom edge by 24px using a negative margin. Its striped band is 40px tall; below it the wordmark at 56% width, the headline at 9vw on two lines, the sentence and the button, all centred. The links wrap into the card's foot.
headline: A warm two-line welcome of three to five words, at most 30 characters, about 15 per line at 5vw (72px at 1440).
bannedWhy: The headline sits on a printed card panel with a striped band; the same headline-in-a-card fault.

name: Giant cropped shape
blueprint: A plain ground with one shape at enormous scale: a photograph of the subject (its material, its object, its place) cut with `clip-path` to the simplest geometry found in the subject (a circle, a ring segment, a chamfered block, an arch), never a drawn or filled shape. It is about 110vh tall on columns 7–12, its right side on the right page margin and its centre at 55% of the height, so the hero's top and bottom crop it. The headline sits on the bare ground on columns 1–6, vertically centred, on the left margin: two lines at clamp(64px, 6.4vw, 100px), heavy weight, tracking -0.03em. Beneath it comes one supporting sentence at 19px, then the single action as the dealt button. The dealt navigation runs across the top.
mobile: The shape moves to the bottom: the full content width between the page margins, its top at 56svh, cut only by the hero's bottom edge. The headline sits above it at 11.5vw on two lines on the page margin, starting 15% down, with the sentence at 16px and the button beneath. The navigation folds behind a Menu word.
headline: Two lines of two or three words each, up to about 12 characters per line at 6.4vw.

name: Fragment on a shaped stage
blueprint: A neutral ground. The headline stands at the left: two lines at clamp(52px, 5.2vw, 80px), medium weight, flush left on columns 1–5 at a 40px margin, starting 150px down. One supporting sentence at 18px, max 34ch, follows, then the single action as a small rectangular button. Beside the words, one flat stage in a saturated colour holds the product: it spans columns 6–12 and ends on the right margin, its top level with the headline's first line (150px down), and runs to the foot of the first screen. It is a plain rectangle in the dealt corner, nothing cut out of it (a box cut to a shape by `clip-path` fails `framed-elements`). On the stage, 56px in from its left and top edges, sits the main fragment of the product's interface at true size with labels at 13–15px, built in HTML and working: one panel or control about 620px wide, cropped by the stage's foot, never a whole window and never inside a browser or laptop frame. It is drawn straight on the stage: its rows, figures and controls in the stage's own ink, with no white panel or card of its own (a window on a filled stage is a box in a box). Mark its root with data-ui. Navigation is a plain row at 28px from the top: wordmark left and four text links right at 15px. Nothing overlaps the headline.
mobile: The headline sits under the wordmark at 10vw on two lines, followed by the sentence at 16px and the button. The stage comes next at full width, bleeding off both sides. The fragment sits 16px inside it at true size; if it is wider than that, show the one panel that fits rather than scaling it down, never cut by the screen's right edge.
headline: A plain statement of what the product does in three to six words, two lines of up to about 13 characters each at 5.2vw.

name: Control that reads the page
blueprint: A near-black or deep neutral ground split into two halves by tone alone: the right half is one step lighter than the left, and they meet at a clean vertical edge at 50%. Left half: a small logo mark top-left at a 40px margin, then two-thirds of empty ground, then everything else anchored bottom-left, 40px from the edges: a headline on one or two lines at clamp(48px, 5vw, 80px) in medium weight, one supporting sentence at 17px in the softer ink held to 44ch, and the single action as a light rectangular button. Right half: one fragment of the product, centred, about 450px square, built in HTML and working. It is the product's defining control (a loupe, a picker, a dial, a field) and it acts on the page itself: it reads the real background colour, the real headline size or the pointer position and prints that value in its own readout at 13px. Mark its root with data-ui so the product's own radii and borders apply inside it. There is no navigation bar; one text link sits top-right at 15px.
mobile: The halves stack as two tones. The fragment comes first: 78vw square, centred in the lighter block, which is 58svh tall, still live and reading the page under the visitor's finger. The darker block below holds the headline at 9vw on up to two lines, the sentence at 16px and the button, left-aligned at 20px. The logo mark sits top-left over the first block.
headline: A plain line naming what the tool is, at 5vw (72px at 1440), up to about 26 characters on two lines.

name: Controls on the sentence
blueprint: A dark flat ground with no logo bar: a 14px wordmark top-left and the single action as an underlined text link top-right, both 28px in. The headline is a two-line sentence, centred, at clamp(96px, 9vw, 150px), line-height 1.0, occupying the middle 64% of the width and sitting slightly above the midline. It is set in a variable font and it is the demonstration. Three small control chips from the product sit on top of the sentence, each about 300 by 80px with the product's true radius, a text label and a numeric readout: one above the first line near its left end, one overlapping the start of the second line, and a two-state switch at the lower right. They are tilted 2 to 4 degrees and filled solid, one step lighter than the ground. Each one works: dragging the first changes the headline's weight through `font-variation-settings`, the second changes its letter-spacing, the third toggles uppercase. Mark each chip's root with data-ui. One supporting sentence at 17px, max 40ch, is centred 72px under the headline. The bottom third of the screen stays empty.
mobile: The sentence stays on two lines at 13.5vw, centred at 38% of the height. The three chips shrink to 200 by 60px and move off the letters: one above the sentence and two side by side beneath it, untilted and still live. The supporting sentence follows at 16px. The wordmark stays top-left and the action link top-right.
headline: A two-line sentence of three to five words, up to about 11 characters per line at 9vw, that still reads when its weight and spacing change.
bannedWhy: Three control chips lie on the headline, one over its second line, and they only restyle the headline: something lying on a headline, controls that do nothing for the product, and data-ui hides them from the inspector (round 6 review).

name: Column on one line
blueprint: A warm off-white page that is more than 80% empty. Everything hangs on one vertical alignment 27% in from the left edge, the start of column 4; nothing is centred and nothing sits to its left. A small logo mark sits on that alignment 56px from the top. About 220px lower the column begins, only 380px wide: a two-line headline at 27px in medium weight, line-height 1.25; one supporting sentence at 15px in the softer ink, line-height 1.5; then, 28px below, the single action as a near-black rectangular button with 4px corners and one text link with an arrow beside it. A sign-in text link sits alone in the top-right corner at 14px; there is no navigation bar. Beside the column, on the same top line, a flat panel one step darker than the page, 368px wide, holds two real rows of the product's interface at true size with one row selected. Mark the panel's root with data-ui. The right half of the screen is blank on purpose, and nothing spans the full width until the footer.
mobile: The alignment becomes the 24px left margin. The logo mark sits 32px from the top and the column starts at 30% of the height: headline at 24px on two lines, the sentence at 15px, then button and text link side by side. The demonstration panel spans the width between the margins and shows its top 120px above the fold. The sign-in link stays top-right.
headline: A dry two-line statement at 27px, up to about 30 characters per line; it never grows larger at any width.

name: Single object on a plinth
blueprint: An off-white screen that is about 80% empty and does not need to scroll. One photographed object stands dead centre: a studio shot on a plain background, shown 440px tall (about half the viewport height) whatever its width, with `mix-blend-mode: multiply` so its backdrop disappears into the page. It rests on a plinth, a rounded square 520px across filled one step lighter than the page and centred behind it, with no border. The wordmark sits top-left at a 56px margin in a heavy serif or grotesk, about 400px wide (28% of the viewport) and 80px tall; it is the only large type. Opposite it, top-right on the same margin and aligned to the wordmark's top, sits the one supporting sentence at 15px, right-aligned, max 36ch. Centred 40px under the plinth is the single action: a compact email field or button 240px wide with 8px corners. Further objects replace the first in the same position by crossfade, each scaled to the same visual mass. There is no navigation. Nothing else touches the edges, and the object never grows beyond half the viewport height.
mobile: The wordmark sits top-left at 44vw wide with 20px margins and the supporting sentence drops beneath it at 14px. The plinth is 78vw square, centred at 54% of the height, with the object 44svh tall on it. The action sits 32px under the plinth, 40px in from each side. The screen stays mostly empty and the objects swap in place.
headline: None beyond the name: the wordmark top-left, up to about 10 characters, is the only large type and the object is the statement.

name: Object cropped by top and bottom
blueprint: A flat off-white or single bold colour field under the dealt navigation. The left 60% of the screen is one object photographed on a plain background and scaled far past its container. Set the image to about 150% of the hero's height, rotate it 10 to 20 degrees and place it on the left 60% from the left page margin, so the top and bottom of the hero crop it; use `overflow: hidden` on the section and `mix-blend-mode: multiply` if the field is light. The headline fills the right half: two stacked lines of very bold lowercase at clamp(120px, 13vw, 210px), right-aligned on the right page margin, tracking -0.05em, line-height 0.86, vertically centred. The object's right-hand contour comes within 24px of the first letters and never covers them. One supporting sentence at 18px, max 28ch, is right-aligned under the headline on columns 9–12. Nothing else is on the screen: no second image, no list.
mobile: The object moves to the top: the image is 150vw wide, rotated, cropped by the top, left and right edges, and occupies the upper 52svh. The headline sits below it at 19vw on two lines, right-aligned on the page margin, clear of the object's lower contour. The supporting sentence follows at 16px, right-aligned.
headline: Two lines of one or two short words each, up to about 8 characters per line at 13vw, set beside the object.

name: Object splits the headline
blueprint: One deep, flat ground colour. The object, a low-key studio photograph whose background matches the ground, stands at dead centre, scaled to 66% of the viewport height and tilted about 8 degrees, with its base cropped by the bottom edge. The headline is split around it: line one is centred across the object's upper fifth and line two across its lower fifth, both at clamp(64px, 5.8vw, 92px), regular weight, spanning columns 2–11, so the object fills the gap where a paragraph would normally sit. The type lies above the object in the stacking order in the light ink, so every letter stays readable where it crosses. At the object's mid-height two small text blocks at 14px face each other: the supporting sentence far left on columns 1–2, and two short facts (size, price) far right on columns 11–12, right-aligned, each 32px from its edge. Wordmark top-left; three text links top-centre; the single action top-right as a small light rectangular tab, the only light solid on the screen. The lower corners stay dark and empty.
mobile: The object is 54svh tall, centred, its base cropped by the bottom edge. Line one of the headline crosses its top at 11vw and line two its lower third at 11vw, both centred inside 16px margins. The side text blocks merge into one 15px sentence under the navigation. Wordmark top-left and the action tab top-right; the links collapse to one word.
headline: A two-line statement of four to six words, up to about 16 characters per line at 5.8vw, with the object standing between the lines.

name: Object on the seam
blueprint: A white or very pale page organised by one change of tone. A square-cornered panel one step darker than the page (a flat pale blue-grey or warm grey) fills the top 44% of the viewport inside 12px margins; the page colour runs below it. The object, photographed on a plain background and blended with `mix-blend-mode: multiply`, straddles the seam between the two tones: it is about 58% of the viewport wide, starts at column 6 and ends on the right margin, with its upper half over the panel and its lower half over the page. The words are few and exact. The headline is two lines at clamp(56px, 5vw, 80px) in medium weight, far left on columns 1–5 at a 32px margin, clear of the object, its first baseline resting exactly on the seam; the second line is set in the softer ink. One supporting sentence at 17px, max 34ch, sits 64px lower on the same margin with the single action as a small rectangular button under it. A plain top row inside the panel at 14px: wordmark left, three text links centred, one text link right.
mobile: The tonal panel takes the top 46svh. The object spans the content width, centred on the seam. The headline sits just under the seam at 9vw on two lines at a 20px margin, with the sentence at 16px beneath and then the button. The wordmark sits top-left inside the panel; the links collapse to one word top-right.
headline: Two short lines at 5vw (72px at 1440), one per line and up to about 13 characters each, the second in the softer ink.

name: Statement beside specimen mosaic
blueprint: The viewport is split 50/50 by tone alone: the left half is the page ground, the right half a field one step darker, meeting at a clean vertical edge with no line. Left half: the wordmark at 22px sits top-left on a 32px margin; under it the statement at clamp(52px, 5.2vw, 84px), bold, tracking -0.04em, leading 1.0, top-left aligned and filling the upper 40% of the half. The lower part of this side stays empty except for one supporting sentence at 18px pinned bottom-left and the single action as a solid rectangle beside it. Right half: a loose mosaic of seven specimen tiles on a 4-column, 3-row grid with 14px gaps. Every tile takes one fill, the page ground, so the tiles read as openings in the darker field, each at 3:4 holding one cut-out item, centred, object-fit: contain, mix-blend-mode: multiply; the items carry the colour, never the tiles. Five cells are left empty so the tiles stagger; one tile spans two columns and two rows; the rightmost column is cropped by the viewport edge. Two text links sit top-right over the darker field. The right half may be position: sticky while the left scrolls.
mobile: The split becomes a stack. The statement comes first at 10.5vw on two lines inside 20px margins, the supporting sentence under it at 16px, then the action. Below, the darker field runs full width and the mosaic becomes two columns of tiles, the right column started 48px lower than the left; five tiles show and the last row is cropped by the bottom of the screen. Navigation is the wordmark and one link.
headline: A 3-5 word statement of what is on offer, at most 28 characters so it holds two lines at 10.5vw on a phone.

name: Specimen wall, docked panel
blueprint: There is no header and no display headline: the whole viewport is a wall of specimens. Square tiles of about 112px (7.8vw) with 8px gaps fill the screen edge to edge in eight rows; alternate rows shift half a tile sideways so the wall reads as brickwork, and tiles at every edge are cropped by the viewport (overflow: hidden on the section). Every tile takes the same fill, the page's surface one step off the ground, and holds one cut-out item at 60% of the tile, centred, with mix-blend-mode: multiply. The items carry the colour, never the tiles. A solid panel in the ink colour, 800px wide (columns 4-9) and about 170px tall with square corners, is docked at the bottom centre, 24px above the bottom edge, covering the tiles behind it. Inside, on 28px padding: the sentence that says what this is at 24px semibold on the left across two lines, the single action as a filled rectangle in the paper colour on the right, and beneath them a row holding the wordmark and four text links at 15px. Nothing else overlays the wall.
mobile: Tiles become 22vw squares with 6px gaps, four and a half per row, still offset as brickwork and cropped at both sides. The panel turns into a full-width block fixed to the bottom of the first screen, about a third of its height: the sentence at 6vw on two lines, the action full width beneath it, the wordmark and links in one wrapped row at 14px. The wall fills everything above.
headline: No display line: one plain sentence of up to 56 characters inside the panel names what the items are.

name: Single specimen with name list
blueprint: Borrowed from a museum plinth. A calm light ground with roughly 70% left empty. The wordmark is set large for a logo, about 28% of the viewport wide (clamp(64px, 6vw, 92px), heavy serif or grotesk), top-left on a 56px margin; one sentence of description at 15px sits top-right on the same margin, its first line aligned to the top of the wordmark. Dead centre stands one specimen: a flat tile in a palette colour, 400px wide and 460px tall (columns 5-8) with a 16px radius, holding a single cut-out item at about 80% of the tile height, object-fit: contain. Left of the tile, in columns 2-4, a vertical list of item names is right-aligned towards it: the selected name in full ink at 20px, the names above and below stepping down in size and opacity (18, 16, 14px; 60, 35, 15%). Choosing a name swaps the item and the tile colour. Below the tile, centred: the item's one-line fact at 14px, then the single action, a filled rectangle 240px wide. Three text links sit bottom-left at 14px.
mobile: The wordmark sits top-left at 11vw with the description sentence beneath it at 15px. The tile takes the full width inside 20px margins at 4:5, starting at 30% of the height. The name list becomes one horizontal row under the tile that scrolls sideways with scroll-snap, the selected name centred in full ink at 18px. The action sits full width at the bottom of the screen; the links move to the footer.
headline: The name itself as an oversized wordmark, up to 10 characters on one line; there is no separate statement.

name: Shouted headline, rising photograph
blueprint: Borrowed from a fashion drop. A near-white or single flat colour field. Navigation is one compact line at the top on 24px margins: condensed wordmark left, three text links centred, the single action right. Directly beneath, a two-line uppercase headline in a bold condensed face at clamp(88px, 11.4vw, 176px), centred, leading 0.88, tracking -0.02em, about 60% of the viewport wide; it occupies the band from 12% to 43% of the height. Immediately under the second line, pulled up with a negative margin of -1.2vw so its top edge tucks behind the letters' baseline, a single portrait photograph rises: 27% of the viewport wide (columns 5-8), 3:4, square corners, object-fit: cover, cropped by the bottom edge so only its upper two thirds show. The photograph is the only colour on the screen. The flanks either side of it stay empty apart from one supporting sentence at 17px bottom-left in a 280px column, and the price or key fact at the same size bottom-right, both on a baseline 32px above the bottom edge.
mobile: The headline sets at 17vw on two lines, flush to 16px margins and filling the width, in the top third of the screen. The photograph widens to 64% of the width, centred, 3:4, starting directly under the headline and running off the bottom. The supporting sentence and the key fact move below the fold. Navigation collapses to the wordmark and the action.
headline: A blunt 2-4 word statement in condensed capitals, at most 22 characters, one or two words per line.

name: Counter object, wide wordmark
blueprint: Borrowed from a watch or perfume counter. One flat charcoal field. Centred slightly above the midline, a single low-key photograph of the object about 31% of the viewport wide (columns 5-8), 4:5, its own dark background matched to the field with filter: brightness(0.9) so it sits without a frame. Under it the name runs on one line as an ultra-wide wordmark spanning 72% of the width yet only about 45px tall: an extended face with letter-spacing near 0.6em, or a regular face stretched with transform: scaleX(2.4). Then one centred serif sentence at clamp(24px, 2.6vw, 38px). Then a single centred row at 15px with 48px between its three parts: one specification, the price inside the one solid light rectangle that is also the action, a second specification. The wordmark repeats small top-left and one text link sits top-right, both on 32px margins. The bottom fifth and both outer quarters of the screen stay empty and dark.
mobile: The photograph grows to 70% of the width at 4:5, its top at 16% of the height. The wide wordmark spans the full width inside 20px margins at about 28px tall. The serif sentence sets at 6vw on two lines. The row stacks into three centred lines with the action in the middle at full width. The lowest sixth of the screen stays dark and empty.
headline: The name as a very wide, very low wordmark on one line (up to 12 characters); the serif sentence beneath is the supporting line, up to 40 characters.

name: Text band, then sheet
blueprint: A black or white field on a seven-column grid with 14px margins and 14px gaps. There is no display type: everything is set at one size, 16px, in one weight. The top band is plain text hanging from a line 20px below the top edge: the name in column one; one sentence on availability in column two; a list of five or six services from column three; a longer list of clients or awards from column five; and two links, profile and the single contact action, at the right end of column seven. Lists run one item per line. Below the lists about 300px of ground is left empty. At mid-height the sheet begins: one thumbnail per column, each the full column width (about 190px) at its natural ratio, top-aligned, with the project title in the text size above the first frame of each run of two to four frames. Rows continue below the fold with 40px between them. Frames have square corners and sit directly on the ground with no border and no caption on the image.
mobile: The grid becomes two columns with 12px gaps. The name and the availability sentence take the top; services and clients sit side by side under them as two short lists at 15px. An 80px gap follows, then the sheet: two frames per row at natural ratios, each project title above its first frame. The contact action is a text link fixed bottom-right.
headline: None at display size: the name is set at 16px with the rest of the text, and one sentence of up to 60 characters says what the person does.

name: Sheet with a text cell
blueprint: The whole viewport is a sheet of photographs: six columns with 12px gaps and 12px outer margins, each column a vertical stack of frames at natural ratios with square corners. Each column starts at a different vertical offset (0, -90, -40, -130, -20, -70px) so rows never line up and the top and bottom frames are cropped by the viewport. Every frame has a flat strip 28px tall fused to its bottom edge in a solid palette colour, carrying one line of 13px text (a title or a place); strip colours rotate through four values. There is no header. In columns 3-4, starting at 28% of the height, one cell of the sheet is not a photograph but a filled panel in the tone opposite to the ground, 410px tall, sitting on the grid like any other frame with the same gaps on all sides. Inside it, top-left aligned on 24px padding: the wordmark at 28px, one sentence at 20px on up to three lines, the single action as a filled rectangle, and three text links on one line at the panel's foot.
mobile: The text panel spans the full width as the first block, about 40% of the screen height, with the wordmark at 7vw, the sentence at 17px and the action full width. Under it the sheet resumes in two columns with 8px gaps, the right column started 60px higher than the left, colour strips kept on every frame. The links sit in one row at the panel's foot.
headline: The wordmark at 28px plus one sentence of up to 70 characters inside the panel; nothing is set at display size.

name: Lit strip, four corners
blueprint: One near-black field with a single lit band. Four small pieces of text at 14px, medium weight, sit in the corners on 72px side margins and 44px top and bottom margins: the name top-left, one link top-right, one sentence saying what this is bottom-left (max 36ch), the single action as a text link bottom-right. Across the vertical middle runs one horizontal strip of photographs, 34vh tall (about 300px), each at its natural width with 10px gaps and square corners: eleven or more frames in a flex row wider than the viewport, so the first and last visible frames are cropped by the left and right edges. The frame nearest the centre is at full brightness; the others sit at filter: brightness(0.55) and brighten on hover or as they reach the centre. Under the centred frame, aligned to its left edge, its title is set in the same 14px text. The top quarter and the bottom quarter of the screen stay empty and dark. The strip scrolls sideways with overflow-x: auto and scroll-snap; never hijack vertical scroll.
mobile: The strip stays a single sideways-scrolling row but grows to 46vh tall, so one frame and the cropped edges of its neighbours fill the width. The name and the link sit at the top on 20px margins; the sentence and the action stack bottom-left under the strip at 14px. Dark space remains above and below the strip, about 12% of the height each.
headline: None at display size: the name at 14px in a corner and one sentence of up to 60 characters.

name: Mosaic masthead, title on axis
blueprint: The top 52% of the viewport is a full-width masthead band built as a gutterless mosaic: a CSS grid of 6 columns and 2 rows in which four cells are photographs (object-fit: cover, all in the one treatment section 0 deals, of one light) and the rest are flat tiles in one palette colour, the same for all. One photograph spans two columns and one flat tile spans both rows; cells butt together with no gap. The header lies flush on the band's upper edge: the wordmark in a solid ink block at far left, a flat accent-coloured tab holding three text links that runs from the block to 42% of the width, and the single action as a text link at the far right. Below the band, on the paper ground: a standfirst of one sentence at 20px on the 16px left margin, max 30ch, and, starting exactly at 42% of the width, the title on two lines at clamp(64px, 8.3vw, 128px), medium weight, tracking -0.06em, leading 0.9, running to the right margin. The title's first baseline sits about 110px under the band.
mobile: The band becomes a mosaic of 3 columns and 2 rows taking the top 38% of the screen: two photographs and four flat tiles in that one colour. The header is a single row above it with the wordmark block and a menu word. The axis collapses to the 16px left margin: the title at 13vw on two lines, then the standfirst at 17px beneath it. The action sits as a text link at the foot of the screen.
headline: The title of the report, programme or product, 2-5 words, at most 26 characters across two lines.

name: Narrow talk, wide headline
blueprint: An asymmetric sheet on one flat paper-grey ground, divided at 34% of the width by alignment only. Left column (columns 1-4, 32px margin): the wordmark top-left; then, starting at 30% of the height, one supporting sentence at 22px with leading 1.35, max 24ch; under it the single action, a solid ink rectangle with square corners. The column's lower third is empty. Right column (columns 5-12): four text links at 15px on its top edge, the first aligned exactly to the 34% line. Beneath them the headline in a very heavy grotesk at clamp(88px, 9.8vw, 150px), two lines, line-height 0.82, tracking -0.04em, flush left on the 34% line and filling the column width. A square-cornered photograph the full width of the right column starts at 68% of the viewport height and is cropped by the bottom edge. A solid accent block 260px wide, carrying one real figure at 40px and one line of text, overlaps the photograph's top-left corner by half its own height using a negative top margin.
mobile: One column on 20px margins. The wordmark and a menu word share the top row. The headline comes first at 15vw on two lines, heavy, line-height 0.85. The supporting sentence follows at 18px, then the action at full width. The photograph runs full bleed below at 4:3, with the accent block overlapping its top-left corner at 60% of the screen width.
headline: A 2-4 word statement in the heaviest weight, at most 20 characters, one or two words per line.

name: Waterline headline
blueprint: Two flat fields fill the viewport and meet at exactly half height: the upper one paper or white, the lower one a saturated palette colour. No image. The headline is two lines of capitals in a black-weight grotesk at clamp(72px, 9vw, 140px), centred, leading 0.86, about 65% of the viewport wide, positioned so the seam cuts through the middle of the second line. Above the seam the letters take the accent ink; below it they switch to a deep ink, as if under water. Build it with two stacked copies of the headline in the same position (the lower copy aria-hidden), each clipped to its own field with clip-path: inset(), or with mix-blend-mode: difference on a single copy if the colours allow. The wordmark sits top-left and the single action, a solid rectangle in the accent ink, top-right, both on 28px margins; there are no other links. Near the bottom, 40px above the edge, one supporting sentence at 20px is centred in the paper colour on the saturated field. Everything else is empty colour.
mobile: The same two fields, meeting at 46% of the height. The headline sets at 15.5vw on two lines, filling the width inside 16px margins, the seam still cutting the second line. The wordmark sits top-left and the action top-right as a small solid rectangle. The supporting sentence sits bottom-left at 17px on the saturated field, on up to three lines.
headline: A blunt statement of 2-4 words in capitals, at most 20 characters, split so each line is one or two words.

name: Flush-left shout, seam photograph
blueprint: Borrowed from a street poster or zine. A saturated flat field covers the top 82% of the viewport; a second flat colour forms a band across the bottom 18%. The headline is two lines in an ultra-heavy face at clamp(80px, 12vw, 190px), flush left on a 20px margin, leading 0.84, reaching about 62% across the width; its first line starts 16% below the top. Right of centre one photograph is stuck on like a poster scrap: a 3:4 portrait 30% of the viewport wide (columns 8-11), clipped to an arch with clip-path or a large top border-radius, rotated 5 degrees, its top edge leaving the viewport and its lower edge straddling the seam so it sits on both colours. The photograph overlaps the last letters of the first line by about 4vw and lies above the type in the stacking order. On the bottom band, on one baseline: one supporting sentence at 20px on the left (max 40ch) and the single action, a chunky rectangle in the upper field's colour, at the right. The wordmark sits top-left at 20px; three text links top-right.
mobile: The field takes the top 78% and the band the rest. The headline sets at 19vw on two lines flush to 16px margins, starting at 12% of the height. The arch photograph moves under the type: 58% of the width, on the right margin, still tilted 5 degrees and straddling the seam. The sentence and the full-width action stack on the band.
headline: A 2-4 word shout, at most 16 characters, lowercase or capitals throughout, one or two words per line.

name: Menu column, sticky photograph
blueprint: The first screen is two halves of equal width inside the page margins, 12px apart. Right half: one photograph of the place filling it edge to edge (object-fit: cover) with the dealt corner, set to position: sticky; top: 12px; height: calc(100svh - 24px), so it stays put while the left half scrolls; nothing is laid over it. Left half: the page's own ground, set the way a menu is set, everything centred. At 34% of the height, the headline at the display step on two lines in the accent ink, max 18ch per line; under it one sentence at the lead step, max 40ch, then the single action as the dealt button. The wordmark stays in the dealt navigation, and the lower quarter of the half is empty ground.
mobile: The photograph comes first, 56svh tall inside the page margins with the dealt corner. Under it on the ground, centred: the headline at 9vw on two lines, the sentence and a full-width action.
headline: A warm 3-5 word line, at most 30 characters, centred on two lines.

name: Inset photograph, crossing wordmark
blueprint: One deep, dark flat field. A tall portrait photograph fills the left 47% of the viewport, inset 20px from the top, left and bottom edges, with a 12px radius and object-fit: cover; it is position: sticky for the length of the page while the right side scrolls. Five text links at 15px sit top-right on a 32px margin, the last of them the single action. There is no logo at the top. In the right half, at 44% of the height and centred on that half's own axis, one supporting sentence in the light ink at 24px on up to three lines, max 26ch. Along the bottom runs the name in lowercase at clamp(120px, 12vw, 200px), light or regular weight, tracking -0.04em, on one line. It starts over the photograph's lower-right corner, overlapping the image by about 10% of the viewport width (z-index above it; mix-blend-mode: difference keeps the letters legible on the picture), and ends flush with the right margin, its baseline 40px above the bottom edge.
mobile: The photograph takes the top 58% of the screen, inset 12px, with the same radius. The name runs under it at 21vw on one line, its ascenders overlapping the photograph's bottom edge by 3vw. The sentence follows at 17px, left-aligned on a 20px margin. Links reduce to a menu word and the action on the top row, set over the photograph.
headline: The name in lowercase on one line, up to 9 characters at this size; a longer name drops to 9vw.

name: Anchored text, specimen half
blueprint: The viewport is split exactly in half by two flat tones that meet at a clean vertical edge: the ground on the left, a palette colour on the right. Left half: the wordmark sits top-left on a 40px margin; the next two thirds of the height are empty; everything else is anchored bottom-left and ends 40px above the bottom edge: a headline on one or two lines at clamp(48px, 5vw, 80px), medium weight; one sentence at 18px in the soft ink, max 38ch; the single action as a solid rectangle. Right half: position: sticky; top: 0; height: 100svh. In its centre sits a square tile in a second palette colour, 450px wide (31vw) with a 24px radius, holding one cut-out item at 70% of the tile, object-fit: contain, mix-blend-mode: multiply on light fills. Under the tile's left corner the item's name and one fact sit at 15px. As the left column scrolls through the catalogue, the tile's item and colour swap to match the entry in view. One text link sits top-right on the colour field.
mobile: The colour half comes first as a block 52svh tall holding the square tile at 62vw, centred, and stays sticky while the text slides over its lower edge. The text block follows on the ground: the headline at 9vw on two lines, the sentence at 16px, the action full width. The wordmark and one link sit on the top row over the colour.
headline: A 3-5 word line at 5vw (72px at 1440), at most 28 characters on two lines; the words and the object share the screen.

name: Two-by-two board
blueprint: A board with 8px outer margins and 8px gaps throughout; every tile is a filled rectangle with one shared radius (0 or 8px). A 60px top row is itself made of tiles: a square ink tile with the logo mark, a wide ground-tone tile holding four text links that begin at the centre line, and an ink tile at the right end holding the single action. Below it the rest of the viewport is a two-by-two grid. Top-left: a paper tile with the name, or its first word, at clamp(96px, 12.5vw, 190px), medium weight, tracking -0.05em, sitting bottom-left on 24px padding. Top-right and bottom-left: photographs covering their tiles (object-fit: cover), two photographs of one shoot and one light, so they read as one set across the board. Bottom-right is divided into two tiles side by side: a dark tile with one sentence at 24px, top-left aligned, and a tile in the accent colour with a second short statement at 24px, also top-left. Text never centres inside a tile. No tile is empty and none is outlined.
mobile: The board becomes one column of tiles with 6px gaps: a top row with the logo tile and a menu tile; the name tile at 30% of the screen height with the name at 22vw bottom-left; one photograph tile at 4:3; then the dark tile and the accent tile side by side as two squares. The second photograph moves below the first screen.
headline: The name, or its first word, up to 8 characters at 12.5vw; the two 24px statements are one sentence each.

name: Name band and rails
blueprint: One viewport filled completely with tiles on 8px gaps and 8px margins. Across the top, a band tile 170px tall holds the name on one line at clamp(140px, 14.4vw, 220px), heavy, tracking -0.04em, centred and deliberately wider than the band so both ends are cropped by the tile's edges (overflow: hidden, white-space: nowrap). Under it a row of four equal tiles, 64px tall, each holding one text link at 16px, top-left aligned. The remaining 62% of the height is three columns. Left rail (columns 1-2): two stacked tiles, a portrait photograph above and a short list of five facts below. Centre (columns 3-10): one large photograph tile, object-fit: cover, with a statement tile in the ground tone laid along its bottom third holding one sentence at clamp(24px, 2.4vw, 36px), top-left aligned on 24px padding. Right rail (columns 11-12): a full-height stack of five flat colour tiles, a light-to-dark run from the palette; the lowest takes the accent colour and holds the single action, the others each carry one short fact at 15px.
mobile: Tiles restack in two columns with 6px gaps. The name band stays full width: 26vw type cropped at both sides in a 110px band. The four link tiles become a two-by-two block. The large photograph tile follows at full width, 4:3, with the statement tile under it at 6vw. The colour rail becomes a horizontal row of five short tiles, the action tile last and twice as wide.
headline: The name on one cropped line, any length, plus one sentence of up to 60 characters in the statement tile.

name: Stepped title, two photographs
blueprint: A pale neutral ground with 6vw side margins on a 12-column grid. Navigation is three small items on the top edge at 15px: one link hard left, the wordmark centred, the single action hard right. The headline is two words or short phrases on two lines in a thin serif at clamp(72px, 8.3vw, 128px), leading 1.0, stepping diagonally across the middle third of the screen: the first line starts at column 2 with its baseline at 44% of the height; the second is indented to start at column 6 and ends near column 12. Two photographs are placed against the step, both with square corners. A small 16:10 landscape in columns 10-12 hangs from 10% of the height and stops about 20px above the first line. A 4:5 photograph in columns 2-5 starts 24px under the first line's baseline, to the left of the indented second line, and is cropped by the bottom edge of the viewport. Under the second line, starting on column 6, one sentence at 20px in the soft ink, max 36ch. Columns 6-12 of the lower third stay empty.
mobile: The step survives: the first line at 15vw flush to the 20px left margin, the second line indented by 22vw. The small landscape sits above the title at 46% of the width, pushed to the right margin. The tall photograph follows the title at 72% of the width on the left margin, cropped by the bottom of the screen; the sentence at 16px moves beneath it.
headline: Two words or short phrases, one per line, at most 9 characters each so the indented second line fits a phone.

name: Three prints, one line
blueprint: Photographs lead and the type stays small. A pale ground, a 12-column grid, 5vw side margins. The top row at 15px holds the wordmark left, three text links centred and the single action right. Three photographs with square corners hang from one shared top line at 18% of the viewport height, like prints pinned along a rail, each a different size so their bottom edges fall at three heights. A small 1:1 in columns 1-2 (about 190px). A tall 3:4 in columns 4-7, about 440px wide and 590px tall, the largest thing on screen. A 16:10 landscape in columns 9-12 that ends on the right margin. Columns 3 and 8 are left empty as breathing space. The headline sits under the small photograph, left-aligned to its left edge across columns 1-3: a light serif or slender sans at clamp(30px, 2.8vw, 44px) on two lines, followed by one sentence at 16px in the soft ink, max 30ch. One line of caption at 14px sits under the left corner of each of the other two photographs.
mobile: The rail turns vertical, so left edges vary instead of bottoms. The tall photograph comes first at 72% of the width on the left margin; the small square follows at 38% of the width, pushed to the right margin and overlapping the first by 40px; the landscape runs full bleed below. The headline at 8vw sits beside the square on the left, with the sentence at 16px under it.
headline: A quiet 3-6 word line at about 40px, at most 36 characters across two lines.

name: Two prints in darkness
blueprint: One near-black field with a slight colour tint, about 75% of it left empty. Navigation is split between the top corners at 15px on 30px margins: the wordmark and three text links top-left, the single action top-right as the page's one solid light rectangle. Two low-key photographs sit in the dark like lit exhibits, both with square corners and no frame. The larger, a 4:5 portrait about 34% of the viewport wide (columns 6-9), has its top at 14% of the height, so it sits a little above the midline. The smaller, a 1:1 about 12% of the viewport wide (columns 2-3), sits far from it with its top at 52% of the height, dimmed with filter: brightness(0.7) so the large one stays the brightest thing on screen. The headline is modest: two lines at clamp(28px, 2.5vw, 40px) in a regular weight, flush to the bottom-left corner on the 30px margin. Columns 10-12 hold one sentence at 16px in the dimmer ink, bottom-aligned to the headline's last baseline, max 24ch. Nothing else is on screen.
mobile: The large photograph takes 78% of the width, pushed to the right margin, its top at 12% of the height. The small square sits at 30% of the width on the left margin, overlapping the large one's lower-left corner by 24px. The headline sets at 6.4vw on two lines bottom-left with the sentence beneath at 15px. The action is a small solid rectangle top-right; links fold behind a menu word.
headline: A quiet statement of 4-7 words at 28-40px, at most 44 characters on two lines.

name: Two-line statement, full width
blueprint: Paper and ink only; no image. The wordmark at 15px sits top-left and two or three text links at the same size top-right, both on 24px margins; there is no bar. The statement fills the upper two thirds: two lines at clamp(96px, 12.5vw, 200px), medium to bold weight, tracking -0.05em, leading 0.86, starting 15% below the top edge. The first line is flush to the left margin and the second flush to the right margin, so the pair spans the full width and steps across the screen. Size the type so the longer line runs margin to margin: tune the vw value to the character count and test it at 1440 and 390. Between the statement and the bottom row about 18% of the height is left empty. The bottom row sits on one baseline 28px above the bottom edge: one supporting sentence at 22px on the left, max 44ch on two lines, and the single action bottom-right as a solid ink rectangle with square corners. There is no colour beyond ground and ink.
mobile: Both lines turn flush left on 16px margins at 17vw, leading 0.9, starting at 14% of the height and filling the width. A gap of about 20% of the screen follows. The sentence sits at 17px above a full-width action, both anchored to the bottom with 20px to spare. Navigation reduces to the wordmark and one menu word.
headline: A 3-5 word statement on two lines, at most 11 characters per line so 17vw type fits a phone.

name: Void, then statement on axis
blueprint: A deliberate void: the upper 60% of the viewport holds nothing but the top row. That row, 44px from the top on 48px margins, has the wordmark at the left margin, two text links starting exactly on a vertical axis at 42% of the width, and the single action at the right margin as a text link. Everything else hangs from the same axis in the bottom third. The statement starts on the 42% line: two lines at clamp(56px, 6.6vw, 104px), regular or medium weight, tracking -0.04em, leading 0.95, running towards the right margin, with its last baseline 72px above the bottom edge. Left of the axis, in columns 1-4, one supporting sentence at 18px in the soft ink, max 32ch, is bottom-aligned to the statement's last baseline. Nothing sits in the left zone above it. No image and no shape; the ground is one flat tone and the ink one colour. The emptiness is composed: three elements share the axis, so the blank area reads as intended and not as a page that failed to load.
mobile: The axis collapses to the 20px left margin. The top 48% of the screen stays empty under the wordmark row. The statement sets at 12.5vw on two lines, flush left, followed by the sentence at 17px and the action as a text link, the whole block ending 28px above the bottom edge. The two links fold behind a menu word.
headline: A 3-6 word statement, at most 30 characters over two lines, about 15 per line at 6.6vw from the axis.

name: Colour field, two-ink statement
blueprint: One saturated flat colour covers the whole viewport; there is no navigation bar and no image. Two short pieces of 15px text sit in the top corners on 3% margins: the wordmark at the left, the single action as a text link in the dark ink at the right. The statement starts 15% down, left-aligned from the 3% margin, in a soft heavy serif or a heavy grotesk at clamp(110px, 14vw, 220px), tracking -0.03em, leaded so tightly (0.82) that the two lines nearly touch. Line one is set in a pale ink and line two in a dark ink, the only two inks on the field; the pair fills the top 55% of the screen and the longer line reaches about 90% of the width. A long name may be broken across the two lines with a hyphen if the second half reads as a word of its own. In the bottom-right corner, right-aligned in a column 24% of the viewport wide, one supporting sentence at 17px in the pale ink. The bottom-left quarter stays empty colour.
mobile: The same field. The corner texts stay at the top at 14px. The statement sets at 21vw on two lines from a 16px margin, starting at 16% of the height, pale line over dark line. The supporting sentence moves to the bottom-left at 16px across 80% of the width, ending 24px above the bottom edge. The middle fifth of the screen stays empty colour.
headline: The name or a two-word statement over two lines, at most 8 characters per line at 21vw on a phone.

name: One word, edge to edge
blueprint: A single word is the whole composition, set as large as the screen allows. No image. The word is one line in a heavy condensed or heavy grotesk face at clamp(200px, 30vw, 480px), line-height 0.8, white-space: nowrap, sized to the word so it spans the width between the page margins and stands whole: its capitals fill the lower half of the screen, its baseline on the bottom margin (32px above the bottom edge), no letter cut by any edge. The top 30% holds everything else on 28px margins: the wordmark at 16px top-left, three text links top-right, and, starting 96px down on the left margin, one supporting sentence at clamp(20px, 1.7vw, 26px), max 34ch, with the single action directly beneath it as a solid rectangle. Ground and ink are two flat values; the word may take the palette's one accent instead of the ink.
mobile: The word turns a quarter turn (writing-mode: vertical-rl) and runs down the right side, ending on the right page margin, sized so it stands whole between the bar and the bottom margin. The left 45% of the screen holds the wordmark, the sentence at 17px and the action, stacked from the top on a 20px margin. Links fold behind a menu word.
headline: One word of 4-8 letters, the name or the single noun the subject owns, whole and readable.

name: Window that opens to the edges
blueprint: A flat paper or pale ground, and one picture seen through a small window that becomes the whole screen as the page scrolls. The hero is a wrapper 200svh tall holding a stage with `position: sticky; top: 0; height: 100svh`. On the first frame the window is a 4:5 portrait opening 36% of the viewport wide (518×648px), centred, its top and bottom 126px from the edges, square corners; give it a shape from the subject if it has one (an arch, a rounded diamond, a lens). Build it as `clip-path: inset(126px 461px)` on a layer that is itself 100vw by 100svh, so the photograph or muted film inside is laid out full-bleed and never moves: only the opening grows. The headline sits left of the window on columns 1–3: two lines at clamp(44px, 4.4vw, 64px), leading 0.95, flush to the 32px margin, its last baseline level with the window's lower edge. Right of the window on columns 10–12, bottom-aligned to the same line: one supporting sentence at 18px, max 26ch, and the single action as a solid rectangular button. Wordmark top-left and three text links top-right at 15px on the same margin; nothing else sits on the ground. Over the first 100svh of scroll the inset runs to zero on a scroll-linked timeline while the text, which sits above the picture layer, rises and fades out before the opening reaches it; the picture then holds full-bleed for 50svh before the next section slides over it. Without scroll timelines, or under reduced motion, show the open picture with the headline over a flat dark scrim in its bottom-left corner.
mobile: The stage stays sticky. The window starts 78vw wide at 4:5, centred, its top at 30% of the height, leaving about a quarter of the screen below it. The headline sits above it at 10vw on two lines inside 20px margins, 72px down; the supporting sentence at 16px and a full-width action sit under the window. The opening reaches the edges within 70svh of scroll. The links fold behind a menu word.
headline: Two short lines of up to about 9 characters each: the name with what it is, or a 2–4 word claim. It scrolls away as the picture takes the screen.

name: Ring of frames around the headline
blueprint: One near-black or deep flat field. Eighteen to twenty-four photographs or film stills sit on an ellipse centred on the viewport, with radii of 560px across and 310px down, so their centres run from x 160 to 1280 and from y 140 to 760. Frames have square corners and no border, mix 4:3 and 3:4, and grow towards the viewer: about 100px wide at the top of the ring and 150px at the bottom and at both ends, so the ring reads as tilted. Each frame is turned so its base lies along the curve (never more than 30 degrees), and neighbours may overlap by up to a fifth. Inside the ring an empty core about 600×340px holds the text, centred: the headline on two lines at clamp(56px, 5.4vw, 80px), leading 0.95, in the light ink; one supporting sentence at 18px, max 40ch, 24px under it; then the single action as a solid light rectangle. Wordmark top-left and three text links top-right at 15px on 32px margins, outside the ring. Every frame is a link to its project: pointing at one, or focusing it, brings it to full brightness, drops the others to 45% and replaces the supporting sentence with that project's name and year. Place the frames with a few lines of trigonometry (left and top in percentages) and keep them still; the wheel scrolls the page as usual.
mobile: The ellipse becomes a circle 132vw across, centred at half height, so the frames at its left and right ends run off both edges and the ring reads as two arcs, one above and one below the text. Keep twelve frames at 64–88px. The headline sits in the core at 10.5vw on two lines inside 28px margins, with the sentence at 16px and the action at the full width of the core beneath it. Wordmark top-left and a menu word top-right sit above the top arc. A tap on a frame opens its project.
headline: A 3–6 word line on two lines, at most about 14 characters per line, so it fits the empty core.

name: Navigation on the midline
bannedWhy: The rail across the middle of the screen is both the navigation and the h1, so the first screen has no header in reach (the inspector's no-nav) and the h1 is set at nav size, about 32px. r8-p38 built it as a mid-screen strip between product cards: the judge read the first screen as a dashboard with no headline. Giving it a top navigation and a display-size h1 would leave nothing of the idea, so it is retired.
blueprint: One photograph or muted film fills the viewport at 100vw by 100svh, `object-fit: cover`, framed so the middle of the screen cuts the subject: a face or a skyline in the upper half, hands or ground in the lower. There is no headline block and nothing in the top or bottom bands. One rail 64px tall runs across the exact vertical centre (its top at 418px) and carries everything on one baseline in the paper colour: the `h1` on the 24px left margin, the name with what it is in two to five words at clamp(32px, 2.6vw, 40px) in medium weight, doing the job of the wordmark; from column 6, one supporting sentence at 18px, max 44ch; at the right margin, two text links at 15px and the single action as a small solid button in the paper colour. If the frame is light behind the rail, give the rail alone a flat dark scrim at 40%. The rail is `position: sticky; top: 0` in the hero's flow, so as the page scrolls it rises with the content and docks as the header bar without changing size or layout, taking the page ground once the pictures have passed. A second full-bleed photograph, a closer detail of the same subject, follows directly beneath, so the rail is seen crossing two pictures before it reaches the top. On a black ground with one photographed object instead of a film, stand the object on the rail at about 17% of the width, between the sentence and the links, so the line seems to pass behind it.
mobile: A portrait crop keeps the subject's middle on the screen's middle.
