The rail stays on the vertical centre, as tall as the `h1` needs at 28px on up to two lines, with the `h1` on the left and Menu on the right. The sentence leaves the rail and sits at 17px in the bottom-left on a 20px margin with the action as a full-width button under it, over a flat dark scrim limited to that corner. The rail docks at the top as on desktop.
headline: The `h1` on the rail: the name with what it is, two to five words at 32–40px on one line, and one sentence of up to 50 characters beside it; the picture does the rest.

name: Title in the sky, line on the horizon
blueprint: One wide photograph or render fills the viewport, chosen with the subject in the lower 55% and open sky, fog or a plain wall above it. The headline is centred in that empty upper zone: two lines at clamp(72px, 7.2vw, 112px), leading 0.9, its cap line 72px from the top, the first line short and the second longer so the block widens towards the subject. On the horizon, with its baseline at 52% of the height, one supporting sentence is split into two halves at 22px: the first half right-aligned to end at column 5, the second left-aligned from column 8, so the subject shows through the 260px gap between them. Wordmark top-left on a 32px margin; up to three text links from column 9; the single action top-right as a solid rectangle in the paper colour. All type is in one ink chosen against the sky; on a pale sky use the photograph's darkest tone rather than black. Nothing else crosses the lower half.
mobile: The picture is re-cropped to portrait with the subject in the lower 45%. The headline sits centred in the sky at 11vw on two lines, 96px down, and the two halves of the sentence become two centred lines at 17px directly under it. The action is a full-width button 24px above the bottom edge on a flat dark scrim band 96px tall. Wordmark top-left and a menu word top-right.
headline: Two lines, the second the longer, at most about 14 characters per line: the name of the place, or a 3–5 word claim about it.

name: Name across the middle
blueprint: Paper and ink only; no picture on the first screen. The name runs on one line across the vertical centre, sized to span from the 18px left margin to the 18px right margin (97.5% of the width). Set it as inline SVG text with a `viewBox` fitted to the word and `width: 100%`, or tune its vw size to the letter count, so it never wraps. In a heavy grotesk the letters stand about 280px tall, from about 310px to 590px; nothing touches or overlaps them. The four corners carry everything else on 18px margins. Top-left: one supporting sentence at 18px on two lines, max 36ch, and 16px below it the single action as a solid ink rectangle. Top-right: a menu word or three text links at 15px. Bottom-left, on a baseline 24px above the edge: the city or the kind of work at 16px. Bottom-right on the same baseline: two or three text links at 15px. The ground between the corners and the name, about 230px above and below it, stays empty and is closed on both sides by the corner texts. The name returns in the footer at the same width with ground and ink swapped and a two-line invitation above it, so the page closes like a bracket.
mobile: The name stays on one line across the width inside 16px margins and moves up to 22% of the height. The supporting sentence follows on the left margin at 17px, then the action at full width. The lower half holds the first picture of the work as a 4:5 frame cropped by the bottom edge, so the screen does not end in empty paper. A menu word sits top-right.
headline: The name itself on one line, up to about 12 characters; the 18px sentence in the top-left corner says what it is.

name: Square over a moving line
blueprint: A white or pale flat ground. One line of display type at clamp(150px, 15vw, 230px), weight 500, tracking -0.02em, runs edge to edge with its cap band centred 360px from the top, moving left at a slow, constant 40px a second: the name, or a claim of two or three words, repeated with a solid round dot one third of the cap height between copies and duplicated for a seamless loop. One square photograph 272px across (19vw), square corners, `object-fit: cover`, sits exactly on the band's centre behind the type, so the words slide across it; the moving line is set twice, the second copy in the paper colour and clipped to the square with `clip-path`, so the letters turn light as they cross the photograph and every word reads whole. It shows the subject's best detail. In the study the photograph sits on top of the words; here nothing lies on top of a headline. 150px under the photograph, centred: one supporting sentence at 22px on two lines, max 36ch, and 24px below it the key fact (a price, a date, an address) at 17px. Top row on 32px margins: one text link on the left, the wordmark centred, one text link on the right. Bottom row on the same margins, 40px above the edge: a location line at 16px on the left and the single action as a solid rectangle on the right. The `h1` holds the moving words once as plain text and the moving copies are `aria-hidden`. Under reduced motion the line stops with one copy centred and both ends cropped.
mobile: The line drops to 34vw with its band at 26% of the height and keeps moving; the photograph shrinks to a 46vw square and stays centred on it. The sentence sits centred at 18px about 64px below the photograph, then the fact at 16px. The action becomes a full-width button 20px above the bottom edge. The wordmark stays centred at the top and the two links fold into a menu word on the right.
headline: The name or a 2–3 word claim of at most 14 characters, set once in the `h1` and repeated in the moving line.

name: Two doors on a dark wall
blueprint: For a subject with two halves a visitor must choose between: two exhibitions, two audiences, two places, two collections. One near-black flat field. Two portrait photographs at 3:4, each 280×373px, stand side by side 80px apart, so the pair spans x 400–1040 (44% of the width) with their tops at 300px; square corners, no frame, the pictures supplying every colour on the screen. Each photograph is the link to its half, and directly beneath it, left-aligned to the frame, sit its name at 22px in the light ink and one line at 16px in the soft ink. The headline is centred above the pair: two lines at clamp(36px, 3.4vw, 52px), leading 1.05, its first line 104px from the top, at most 26 characters per line. Wordmark top-left and one text link top-right at 15px on 32px margins. About 150px of dark ground stays below the pair and 400px either side of it, closed by the two doors at the centre. Pointing at or focusing one door keeps it at full strength and dims the other to 50%. The page continues below with the two halves in order, so each door is also an anchor to its half.
mobile: The pair stays side by side: each photograph 168px wide at 3:4 with a 14px gap, centred at 46% of the height, its name at 17px and its line at 16px beneath it. The headline sits above at 8vw on two lines, centred, 64px down. The wordmark and the link stay in the top corners.
headline: A 4–8 word sentence on two lines that names the choice, at most 26 characters per line.

name: Title from the top edge to the bottom edge
blueprint: One full-bleed photograph or film at 100vw by 100svh, with a horizon near half height and empty sky or darkness above. The headline is two lines in a heavy face at clamp(140px, 13vw, 200px), leading 0.85, pulled as far apart as the screen allows: line one flush to the 32px left margin with its cap line 72px from the top; line two indented 28vw (403px) and anchored to the bottom, its descenders on the bottom margin, 32px above the lower edge, running towards the right margin. Lay the hero out as a grid of three rows (`grid-template-rows: auto 1fr auto`): line one in the first row, line two in the third, both spans of one `h1` with `display: contents`. The middle row leaves the picture clear apart from one supporting sentence at 18px, max 44ch, crossing the horizon at 48% of the height from 30vw, and the single action directly beneath it as a solid rectangular button with its label at 18px. The wordmark and two text links sit top-right on the 32px margin at 15px; the top-left belongs to line one. Choose a picture whose upper-left and lower-right are calm enough for the type, or lay a flat dark scrim under those two corners only.
mobile: Keep the two lines at 19vw: line one flush left on a 16px margin 88px down, line two right-aligned to the 16px margin with its descenders 20px above the bottom. The sentence at 17px and the action button sit between them on the left margin, at 46% of the height. The picture is re-cropped to portrait around the horizon.
headline: Two words or short phrases, one per line, at most about 8 characters each.

name: Line-up on an arc
blueprint: For a range: flavours, colourways, editions, sizes. One deep flat ground, which may take the current item's own colour. The current item, a cut-out photograph, stands at the exact centre about 240px wide and 450px tall (y 210–660), tilted no more than 8 degrees. Its siblings stand behind it on a shallow arc, alternately a little higher and lower: each step out is 30% smaller, a quarter darker (`filter: brightness()`) and about 260px further from the centre, three on each side, so the outermost pair is cut by the left and right edges. Under the current item, centred: its name at clamp(32px, 2.8vw, 44px) and one fact at 17px (what it tastes of, what it is made of, the price). The headline sits top-left on columns 1–4 at clamp(36px, 3.2vw, 48px) on two lines with the supporting sentence at 17px under it; the single action, a solid rectangle, sits top-right on a 32px margin. The arc is a horizontal scroller with `scroll-snap-type: x mandatory`, each item snapping to the centre, its scale and brightness set from its distance to the centre, so a drag, a swipe, the arrow keys or a click on a sibling brings it forward; the ground colour follows with a 300ms transition. No arrows drawn on the screen and no counter.
mobile: The current item takes 55% of the width and half the height, centred at 46% of the height; one sibling peeks in at each edge at 60% scale, half cut off. The headline sits at the top at 8vw on two lines with the supporting sentence beneath; the item's name and fact sit under the item at 24px and 16px. The action becomes a full-width button 20px above the bottom edge.
headline: A plain 3–6 word line on two lines, at most 20 characters per line; the item's own name under the object changes with the selection.

name: View with its next steps in the corner
blueprint: One photograph or muted film fills the viewport, `object-fit: cover`, with the subject in the right half. The headline sits on the left at mid-height: two lines at clamp(44px, 3.9vw, 60px), bold, leading 1.08, flush to the 32px margin on columns 1–5, the block vertically centred; 20px below it, one supporting sentence at 18px, max 40ch, in the paper colour. In the bottom-right corner, on the photograph's calm part, on the right page margin and 40px above the bottom edge, the next steps after the single action stand as two text links at 18px in the paper colour, stacked 12px apart: the titles of the two newest things (a project, an edition, an article), each with an arrow (→), with no box, no card and no thumbnail. The single action is the dealt button top-right beside a menu word. One short fact at 16px in the paper colour may be pinned onto the subject itself, beside a solid 8px dot on the point it describes, with no line joining them. Wordmark top-left on the 32px margin. If the left half is light, lay a flat dark scrim under columns 1–6 only.
mobile: The picture is re-cropped to portrait with the subject in the upper half. The headline sits at 9vw on two lines on the 16px margin at 44% of the height, with the sentence at 16px beneath it. The two next-step links stack at the bottom on the page margin at 16px, on the picture's calm part. Wordmark top-left; the action and a menu word top-right.
headline: A plain two-line claim of 4–7 words, at most about 17 characters per line at 3.9vw.

name: Product under the headline
blueprint: The headline and one sentence sit at the top of the content width, left-aligned (centred only above an interface fragment, and then for the whole page), with the action under them and at most a quieter second beside it. Below, the product fills the width of the content area: a large interface fragment built in HTML (data-ui), or the object or what it produces photographed and running to the content edges, starting in the first screen and cropped by the hero's bottom edge at 100svh, so nothing of the next section shows. Generous space above the headline; the product is the largest thing on the screen.
mobile: The same order: headline, sentence, action, then the product at the full content width inside the page margins, cropped by the hero's bottom edge rather than scaled to illegibility.
headline: What it is or what it does, two to six words, at the dealt display step.

name: Words beside the product
blueprint: The content width is split about 5 to 7. The headline, one sentence and the action sit in the narrower part, vertically centred or aligned to the top of the picture; the headline is large, 5vw or more (72px at 1440) on two lines at most, since a small headline beside a half-screen picture reads as a shop template. The wider part holds the product, the object or the real place, large, from the split to the right margin at the full height of the first screen. When the words cannot be that large in their part, the picture goes full-bleed behind them instead, with the words on its calm side. Nothing else on the first screen.
mobile: Words first, then the picture at full width.
headline: What it is, two to five words, at most about 26 characters.

name: Photograph with a line
blueprint: One sharp photograph fills the first screen under the navigation. A short line (the collection, the season, the place) and one action sit in the photograph's calmest area, usually the lower left, on the photograph itself with enough contrast (a flat dark scrim only if needed). The photograph is chosen for that calm area; nothing else is on the screen.
mobile: A portrait crop of the same photograph, the line and action in its calm area or directly under it on the ground.
headline: Two to five words; it names, it does not explain.

name: Two photographs and a line
blueprint: Two photographs of one family stand side by side, together filling the first screen's width, at the same height or one taller. The line and the action sit under them or across the lower edge of one of them. The two pictures say something together (the product and its use, the place and its detail).
mobile: The first photograph full width, the line and action, then the second photograph.
headline: Two to five words.

name: The object on a plain ground
blueprint: One object and its name on the page's own plain ground. The name, or the page's idea in one to three words, is the largest type on the screen: the display step, on one line across the top, on the centre axis. Directly under it one sentence says what the thing is (and, for a name that means something, what it means), then one action: one button, not a pair. Under them the object stands large on that same ground, 55-70% of the screen's height, its foot on or near the bottom edge: photographed or generated on a plain backdrop and cut out, or set on a ground sampled from that backdrop, so no edge of the photograph shows. No box, frame, corner, plinth or panel of another tone round it, and nothing drawn. Nothing else, and never the object as a photograph card under a centred stack: when the only picture of it stands in its own room or on its own counter, redraw the hero.
mobile: The name across the top at full width, the sentence and the action under it, then the object at about 85% of the width on the same ground, its foot near the bottom of the first screen; no box and no corners round it.
headline: The name of the product or the place, or the page's idea in one to three words, as the largest type on the screen; the sentence under it says what it is and what is new about it.

name: The answer first
blueprint: The headline says what the service is and for whom; one sentence; the action. Beside or under it one real picture of the place or the people at work. Beside it, the headline is 5vw or more (72px at 1440); a headline that cannot be that large goes above the picture, or over it full-bleed. Under both, three or four facts a visitor would otherwise search for (price from, where, when, how long a stay or a session lasts, never a travel time the brief does not give), each a short line at the lead step that says the whole fact ("From 39 € a night, breakfast included"), never a band of big figures over one-word labels. The facts are true and complete.
mobile: Headline, sentence, action, picture, then the facts as a short list.
headline: What it is and for whom, three to eight words; at most about 28 characters when it stands beside the picture.

name: The product at phone width beside the words
blueprint: The words take the wide part of the screen and the product the narrow one. Columns 1–7, from about 20% down: the headline at clamp(64px, 6vw, 104px) on two lines, flush left, one sentence at the lead step under it (max 40ch), then the action. Columns 9–11: the product's window as it runs on a phone, built in HTML (data-ui) at its true width, about 390px at 1440, in the page's palette, its top corners at the dealt corner, with no bezel, no notch and no device frame. Its top is level with the headline's first line and it runs on past the hero's foot, so the hero's bottom edge cuts it. It holds one view full of real content (a list, a note, a conversation, a total) with one item selected, its text 14px or more. Columns 8 and 12 stay plain ground, so the screen stands clear of the words and of the margin. Nothing else on the first screen.
mobile: Words first: the headline at 10vw on two lines, the sentence at 16px and the action. Then the screen at 78vw, centred, cut by the hero's foot.
headline: What it does and for whom, three to seven words on two lines of up to about 16 characters.

name: Words, window and facts in three columns
blueprint: Three columns hung from one top line about 20% down, and nothing spanning the width. Columns 1–6: the headline at clamp(56px, 5.4vw, 88px) on two lines, one sentence at the lead step under it (max 36ch) and the action. Columns 7–10: the product's window in portrait, built in HTML (data-ui) at true size with labels 13px or more, in the page's palette with the dealt corner and no browser bar or device frame; its top on the top line, its foot cut by the hero's bottom edge, one view of real content with one item selected. Columns 11–12: two or three facts a buyer checks first, from the brief (who it is for, what it works with, what it costs where the brief says), each a figure or a short phrase at the h4 step over one line at body size, stacked 40px apart from the top line down, on the ground with no box, no rule and no icon. Every column starts on the top line.
mobile: Words first: the headline at 10vw, the sentence and the action. Then the facts as one row of two or three, then the window at the content width, cut by the hero's foot.
headline: What it does and for whom, three to seven words on two lines of up to about 15 characters.

name: The window across a change of tone
blueprint: One change of tone organises the screen. A square-cornered panel of the surface tone fills the top 60% of the first screen inside 12px margins, and the ground runs below it. Columns 1–5, on the panel: the headline at clamp(56px, 5.4vw, 88px) on two lines, flush left on the page margin, its first line about 22% down; one sentence at the lead step (max 34ch) and the action under it, ending above the seam. Columns 6–12: the product's window, built in HTML (data-ui) at true size with labels 13px or more, its top level with the headline's first line and its foot cut by the hero's bottom edge, so it crosses the seam: its upper part on the panel, its lower part on the ground. It is one plain window with the dealt corner and the ground as its fill, no browser bar and no device frame, showing one view of real content with one item selected. The seam is the only line on the screen: no rule, no shadow, nothing else crossing it.
mobile: The panel takes the top 56svh: the headline at 10vw on two lines on it at a 20px margin, the sentence at 16px and the action. The window spans the content width from the panel's lower part across the seam and is cut by the hero's foot.
headline: What the product does, three to six words on two lines of up to about 13 characters.

name: The window first, the words beside it

Columns 8–12: the words, flush left, their top level with the window's top: the headline at clamp(56px, 5.4vw, 88px) on two lines, one sentence at the lead step (max 34ch) and the action.
